title.en: Make Today’s Sprint the primary learning entry
title.zh: 将今日速成提升为主要学习入口

purpose.en: Make the short five-skill session easy to discover from the home page, Play, a subscribed course, and the signed-in learner dashboard while clarifying the Course and College order.
purpose.zh: 让五技能短时学习可从首页、边玩边学、已订阅课程和登录用户面板轻松进入，并统一课程与学院的先后顺序。

en: Place Choose course before Choose College in the shared header, home actions, and home content flow.
Redesign the home Today task as one image, gradient overlay, learning summary, and full-card link to Play.
Make Today’s Sprint the first Play tile with twelve-language selection and 5, 10, 15, or 20 minutes; ten minutes remains selected by default.
Add a top Today’s Sprint dashboard panel with joined-language tiles, an independent time choice per language, and an Add language tile.
zh: 在共享导航、首页操作区和首页内容流中，把选择课程放在选择学院之前。
把首页今日任务重做为图片、渐变信息层、学习摘要和整卡可点击入口。
将今日速成设为边玩边学第一项，支持十二种语言及 5、10、15、20 分钟选择，默认 10 分钟。
在登录用户面板顶部新增今日速成区，按已加入语言显示卡片，每张独立选时，并提供添加语言入口。

en: Shared header
Home page
Play page
Course learning menu
Member dashboard
Sprint rankings
Administrator Project report
zh: 共享导航
首页
边玩边学
课程学习菜单
用户面板
速成排行榜
管理员 Project 报告

en: Rename learner-facing Daily Sprint copy to Today’s Sprint while retaining the existing server-authoritative plan and scoring model.
Route Play selections to the chosen language’s Beginner-course Sprint with the selected duration.
Use active joined-course data for dashboard language tiles and prefer the language’s Beginner course when available.
Keep sign-in, active course membership, server grading, rankings, and reward boundaries unchanged.
zh: 将面向学员的每日速成名称统一为今日速成，同时保留现有服务器权威计划与评分模型。
边玩边学选择完成后进入所选语言的初级课程今日速成，并携带所选时长。
用户面板语言卡来自有效已加入课程数据，有初级课程时优先使用该课程。
登录、有效课程会员、服务器评分、排行榜和奖励边界保持不变。

en: TypeScript, changed-file ESLint, sensitive-data scan, and the production build pass.
The full repository suite passes after updating the intentional Course-before-College contract.
WebKit runtime layout passes 260/260 checks across 26 routes, Chinese and English, and five phone, iPad, and desktop viewports.
Shared policy, architecture, base-feature consistency, and all 11 SmartLingo shared contracts pass.
zh: TypeScript、本次文件 ESLint、敏感数据扫描和正式构建通过。
更新明确的课程先于学院合同后，全仓测试通过。
WebKit 运行布局通过 260/260 项：26 个路由、中英文和 5 种手机、iPad、桌面尺寸。
共享政策、架构、基础功能一致性及 SmartLingo 全部 11 项共享合同通过。

en: Automated production browser QA cannot provide a real human speech sample; it verifies navigation and the microphone-ready state without inventing a pronunciation score.
zh: 自动正式站浏览器验收无法提供真人语音样本；它会验证导航与麦克风就绪状态，但不会伪造发音成绩。

en: This release changes SmartLingo learning discovery only and does not alter other portfolio sites or their navigation.
zh: 本次只调整 SmartLingo 学习入口，不改变其他站点及其导航。
